raw_tokens.value: Mythic Feat Output ~ Voice of the Sibyl
You overpower weaker and more vulnerable minds with your voice alone.

You gain a +%1 bonus on all Bluff, Diplomacy, and Perform (oratory) skill checks. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Voice of the Sibyl. If you have 10 or more ranks in at least two of these skills, gain a +2 bonus to the DC of any language-dependent spell you cast.|max(1,floor(MythicLevel/3))
